measurement: The complete four-depth construction/admission/exhaustion/recovery recipe is measured as one absolute group, first and repeated invocations. It is not a per-depth scaling benchmark or an internal resource bound.
limitations: No all-depth claim, complete stack/heap bound, coefficient-growth bound or cancellation contract is inferred.
source_sharing: Supporting-line point witnesses are inline records. Import record limits bound that serialized tree; they do not bound expansion of shared in-memory point sources during export. The four-depth regression is a linear nesting recipe, not a branching DAG scaling benchmark. Point-source graph interning and export work/size limits remain open.
